notes: Example overlay only. The numbers are placeholders for one installed stage and are not a statement about any device; replace them with the measured travel (and any bench clearance) of the stage before hardware use. The driver declares both motion inputs operator_required, so without this file every move is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET.

positions.reason: example only: the measured travel of the stage at this bench; replace it with the travel and clearance of the installed stage

displacements.reason: example only: the largest single displacement this bench permits per axis; replace it with the travel and clearance of the installed stage
